House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Higher Education Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; directing the Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities to convene a workgroup on adjunct faculty health care eligibility; requiring a report.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+WORKGROUP ON ADJUNCT FACULTY HEALTH INSURANCE ELIGIBILITY. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Establishment.+]

[+The Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities must convene a workgroup by August 15, 2026, to review current health insurance eligibility requirements for adjunct faculty and develop recommendations for expanding eligibility opportunities. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Membership.+]

[+The workgroup must consist of, at a minimum, representatives from the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities system office, representatives designated by the Inter Faculty Organization, and representatives designated by the Minnesota State College Faculty. +]

[+Subd. 3.+]

[+Duties.+]

[+The workgroup must identify barriers that prevent adjunct faculty from qualifying for employer-sponsored health coverage and develop specific policy and budgetary recommendations to expand health insurance access for adjunct faculty members. +]

[+Subd. 4.+]

[+Report.+]

[+By December 15, 2027, the Board of Trustees must submit a report containing the workgroup's findings and recommendations to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over higher education finance and policy. +]

[+Subd. 5.+]

[+Expiration.+]

[+The workgroup expires on February 14, 2028. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; directing the Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities to convene a workgroup on adjunct faculty health care eligibility; requiring a report.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. WORKGROUP ON ADJUNCT FACULTY HEALTH INSURANCE ELIGIBILITY.

Subdivision 1.

Establishment.

The Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities must convene a workgroup by August 15, 2026, to review current health insurance eligibility requirements for adjunct faculty and develop recommendations for expanding eligibility opportunities.

Subd. 2.

Membership.

The workgroup must consist of, at a minimum, representatives from the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities system office, representatives designated by the Inter Faculty Organization, and representatives designated by the Minnesota State College Faculty.

Subd. 3.

Duties.

The workgroup must identify barriers that prevent adjunct faculty from qualifying for employer-sponsored health coverage and develop specific policy and budgetary recommendations to expand health insurance access for adjunct faculty members.

Subd. 4.

Report.

By December 15, 2027, the Board of Trustees must submit a report containing the workgroup's findings and recommendations to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over higher education finance and policy.

Subd. 5.

Expiration.

The workgroup expires on February 14, 2028.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: WORKGROUP ON ADJUNCT FACULTY HEALTH INSURANCE ELIGIBILITY.

The Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities must convene a workgroup by August 15, 2026, to review current health insurance eligibility requirements for adjunct faculty and develop recommendations for expanding eligibility opportunities.

The workgroup must consist of, at a minimum, representatives from the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities system office, representatives designated by the Inter Faculty Organization, and representatives designated by the Minnesota State College Faculty.

The workgroup must identify barriers that prevent adjunct faculty from qualifying for employer-sponsored health coverage and develop specific policy and budgetary recommendations to expand health insurance access for adjunct faculty members.

By December 15, 2027, the Board of Trustees must submit a report containing the workgroup's findings and recommendations to the chairs and ranking minority members of the legislative committees with jurisdiction over higher education finance and policy.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
